_comment: Wyvrn harness hook template. Merge the `hooks` key into your own ~/.claude/settings.json - do not replace the file, it also holds your permissions, plugins, and model. PreToolUse: refuses any Bash call while a build or test process is alive, so two toolchain invocations can never overlap. Concurrent ctest/cmake runs have hard-crashed developer machines. PostToolUse: runs clang-format on edited C++ sources only. Requires clang-format on PATH; if it is absent the hook fails loudly on every C++ edit, so install it or drop the PostToolUse block.
_caveat_pretooluse: This blocks EVERY Bash call while ctest/cmake/hostharness is running, not just build commands - including the command that would kill a stale orphan. If you get stuck, sweep from PowerShell instead: Get-Process hostharness,ctest,cmake | Stop-Process -Force

hooks.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$c = @(Get-Process ctest,cmake,hostharness -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue); if ($c.Count -gt 0) { Write-Error 'BLOCKED: build/test process already running. Kill it or wait.'; exit 2 }"
